candidate_relations.reason: Frontal-sinus secretions are secondary obstruction; the mass itself is a neoplasm, not sinusitis.
A mucocele may coexist from obstructed secretions but is not the resected fronto-ethmoid mass.
Cellular schwannoma is a histologic subtype of schwannoma, but the record does not establish the cellular variant.
Rhabdomyosarcoma is a distinct malignant myogenic tumor, not supported as the diagnosis of this nasal-cavity mass.
Hemangiopericytoma/solitary fibrous tumor is a different mesenchymal neoplasm from schwannoma.
Proptosis is from mass effect of a nasal/orbital tumor, not primary orbital inflammatory disease.

case_quality_flags: Reference is schwannoma, but no candidate is unmodified schwannoma; histology of cellular subtype is not in the record
